name: The Nanny
description: That flashy girl from Flushing with the heart of an angel (and the voice of a slighty more nasal angel). The comic misadventures of the sweet and sassy Fran Fine, her sophisticated employer, Broadway producer Mr. Sheffield, his boisterous brood and his wisecracking staff.

videos.title: The Making of The Nanny
videos.overview: This brief "Making Of The Nanny" retrospective from 2005 includes interviews with a few of the cast and crew members, including Fran Drescher, Ann Morgan Guilbert, Nicholle Tom, and others.

videos.title: Oy to the World - An Animated Christmas Special
videos.overview: Fran, her talking dog Chester and Brighton magically journey to the North Pole to save Christmas.

videos.title: The Nanny Reunion: A Nosh to Remember
videos.overview: The Nanny gang comes back to say hi and catch up on old times, and watch bloopers.

videos.title: The Nanny
videos.overview: Fran has just been dumped by her fiancé and employer, and is selling cosmetics door-to-door, when she happens to be in the right place at the right time.

videos.title: Smoke Gets in Your Lies
videos.overview: When Brighton is caught smoking at school, Fran thinks it might be her fault.

videos.title: My Fair Nanny
videos.overview: Fran agrees to be made over by Niles and Maxwell in order to host a social.

videos.title: The Nuchslep
videos.overview: Fran chaperones Maggie and her date, who ends up being attracted to Fran.

videos.title: Here Comes the Brood
videos.overview: C.C. tells Grace that Fran acts like she loves them only because she's paid to.

videos.title: The Butler, the Husband, the Wife and Her Mother
videos.overview: Niles poses as Fran's husband to impress her visiting relatives.

videos.title: Imaginary Friend
videos.overview: Fran and Maxwell face a sticky situation after Fran eats Grace's imaginary friend.

videos.title: Christmas Episode
videos.overview: Fran celebrates her first Christmas with the family.

videos.title: Personal Business
videos.overview: Fran agrees to help Maxwell close a deal by dating a young and restless soap-opera star.

videos.title: The Nanny-in-Law
videos.overview: Maxwell's beloved Nanny Mueller makes herself at home, but makes Fran feel insecure.

videos.title: A Plot for Nanny
videos.overview: Fran begins dating a funeral director she meets through her mother.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Fran directs Grace's school production until Maxwell takes over.

videos.title: Maggie the Model
videos.overview: A former model sets up a photo test for Maggie, but Fran is pushed out of the picture.

videos.title: The Family Plumbing
videos.overview: Fran catches her young cousin kissing Brighton in the bathtub.

videos.title: Deep Throat
videos.overview: Fran has to have her tonsils removed, so Maxwell puts C.C.'s reunion on hold to await the outcome of Fran's surgery.

videos.title: Schlepped Away
videos.overview: On the way to catch a flight to the islands, heavy snow maroons the family at Fran's parents' home in Queens.

videos.title: Stop the Wedding, I Want to Get Off
videos.overview: Fran plans a wedding for Maxwell's sister, but she's in love with her chauffeur, not her fiancé.

videos.title: Sunday in the Park with Fran
videos.overview: Fran has a run-in with the son of the town's toughest critic, and that could be catastrophic for Maxwell and CC's new play.

videos.title: The Gym Teacher
videos.overview: Maggie's tyrannical gym teacher turns out to be Fran's former teacher. Maxwell hires an abrasive megastar.

videos.title: Ode to Barbra Joan
videos.overview: C.C. won't warm up to her father's offer of Streisand tickets, but Fran's hot to go in her place.

videos.title: Frannie's Choice
videos.overview: Fran accepts a proposal from the guy who once dumped her.

videos.title: I Don't Remember Mama
videos.overview: Fran and Grace enter a mother-daughter pageant at the country club.

videos.title: Fran-Lite
videos.overview: Maxwell dates a woman with a striking resemblance to Fran.

videos.title: The Playwright
videos.overview: A man whom Fran snubbed in high school has written a play and threatens to jump off a ledge unless Maxwell reads it.

videos.title: Everybody Needs a Bubby Sometimes
videos.overview: Grandma Yetta stays with Fran and the Sheffields while her retirement home is being fumigated.

videos.title: Material Fran
videos.overview: Fran goes out with a much older rich man.

videos.title: Curse of the Grandmas
videos.overview: Gracie's Red Robin troop goes to Grandma Yetta's retirement home to "adopt" a grandparent. When Gracie's first and second picks pass away, it sours her on scouting.

videos.title: The Nanny-Napper
videos.overview: On the subway, a Russian immigrant accidentally leaves her baby, and Fran picks it up, believing it to be abandoned.

videos.title: A Star Is Unborn
videos.overview: A director plans to sabotage his production of "Romeo and Juliet" by casting Fran in the lead role.

videos.title: Pishke Business
videos.overview: Maxwell has Fran pretend to be C.C. in order to get theatrical backing from a man C.C. attacked to get a cab.

videos.title: Stock Tip
videos.overview: Fran gives Maxwell a stock tip that turns out to be from a hot dog vendor.

videos.title: The Whine Cellar
videos.overview: C.C.'s vision for a romantic weekend hit a snag when she and Fran end up locked inside Maxwell's wine cellar together.

videos.title: When You Pish Upon a Star
videos.overview: Fran inadvertently persuades an obnoxious child star, who's set to star in Maxwell's revival of "Oliver!", to give up show business.

videos.title: Take Back Your Mink
videos.overview: Maggie is upset when Fran inherits a mink coat. Fran decides to give it up to appease Maggie, but Sylvia won't hear of it.

videos.title: The Strike
videos.overview: There's a busboy strike going on at the cast party for Maxwell's latest play. When Fran refuses to cross the picket line, a photo of Maxwell dragging her out of the line makes the news.

videos.title: I've Got a Secret
videos.overview: Maxwell refuses to divulge the identity of the celebrity recuperating from surgery in the Sheffields' house.

videos.title: Kindervelt Days
videos.overview: Fran receives a surprise when Sylvia sends in a long-lost "Win a Date With Erik Estrada" contest entry form.

videos.title: Canasta Masta
videos.overview: After Brighton joins Sylvia's canasta team, Fran is dumped from it.

videos.title: The Will
videos.overview: Maxwell draws up a will which states that Fran will remain nanny in the event of his death. Meanwhile, she thinks that a fax of a potential client's heart-sensitive diet given to Niles is really for Maxwell.

videos.title: The Nanny Behind the Man
videos.overview: In an attempt to score a play by award-winning playwright Dakota Williams, Fran and Maxwell set him up to go out with Yetta. The romantic sparks are there—but the play's script may not be.

videos.title: A Fine Friendship
videos.overview: Fran strikes up a friendship with a male nanny whom she erroneously assumes is gay.

videos.title: Lamb Chop's on the Menu
videos.overview: C.C. plans to move into feature film production with a star vehicle for Shari Lewis and Lamb Chop. When Shari and Lamb Chop visit the Sheffield mansion, C.C.'s dog Chester tries to eat Lamb Chop.

videos.title: Close Shave
videos.overview: Maggie is a candy striper at the hospital. When she takes off to go on a date, Fran fills in for her and must shave Maxwell for an appendectomy.

videos.title: What the Butler Sang
videos.overview: Maxwell hears Niles singing and asks him to sing for his backers' audition. Meanwhile, Fran clashes with her sister Nadine.

videos.title: A Kiss Is Just a Kiss
videos.overview: Maggie is upset when Fran beats her in a kissing contest. The winner is to appear on an album cover with Billy Ray Cyrus.

videos.title: Strange Bedfellows
videos.overview: Fran worries about her future when Mona, one of her fellow nannies, retires to Florida. The night of Mona's goodbye party, Fran gets drunk and staggers into Maxwell's bed.

videos.title: The Chatterbox
videos.overview: Maggie receives a party invitation so Fran takes her to her favorite beauty salon. Fran gets a job there for an actress who loses a Sheffield audition.

videos.title: Fran Gets Mugged
videos.overview: An valuable Shakespearian document is taken from Fran when she is mugged in New York's Central Park.

videos.title: Pen Pal
videos.overview: Fran worries about seeing a lifelong pen pal for the first time.

videos.title: Franny and the Professor
videos.overview: C.C.'s college professor brother bets he can make Fran a "Jeopardy" contestant.

videos.title: Dope Diamond
videos.overview: Much to Maxwell's dismay, a handsome doctor proposes to Fran.

videos.title: A Fine Family Feud
videos.overview: Fran's plan for Maggie's Sweet Sixteen party uncovers an old Fine family feud.

videos.title: Val's Apartment
videos.overview: Fran decides to get a place of her own.

videos.title: Shopaholic
videos.overview: The news of her ex-fiancée's engagement sends Fran into a shopping frenzy.

videos.title: Oy Vey, You're Gay
videos.overview: Maxwell falls in love with his publicist, unaware that she's gay.

videos.title: The Party's Over
videos.overview: Fran throws a singles party while Maxwell is away.

videos.title: The Two Mrs. Sheffields
videos.overview: A visit by Maxwell's mother results in an unexpected marriage proposal.

videos.title: Having His Baby
videos.overview: Fran decides to have a baby.

videos.title: The Unkindest Cut
videos.overview: Brighton's tape of a Fine family Bris leads him and his family to Hollywood for a TV appearance.

videos.title: The Kibbutz
videos.overview: Though Maxwell wants to send Maggie to a Swiss convent, Fran convinces her to try a kibbutz instead.

videos.title: An Offer She Can't Refuse
videos.overview: Fran unwittingly accepts a date with a suave mobster.

videos.title: Fashion Show
videos.overview: Maxwell hires Fran to design the costumes for a charity benefit.

videos.title: Where's Fran?
videos.overview: Maxwell's insults cause Fran to quit.

videos.title: The Grandmas
videos.overview: Fran lobbies for change, only to discover her parents are getting divorced.

videos.title: Val's Boyfriend
videos.overview: Val's' new boyfriend makes an unexpected pass at Fran; C.C. quits after Maxwell refuses to make her a partner.

videos.title: Love Is a Many Blundered Thing
videos.overview: Convinced he's her secret admirer, Fran prepares an elaborate Valentine's Day surprise for Maxwell.

videos.title: Your Feets Too Big
videos.overview: An upcoming modeling reunion has Fran worried about aging.

videos.title: Where's the Pearls?
videos.overview: Fran loses both her memory and Elizabeth Taylor's priceless pearl necklace in an accident.

videos.title: The Hockey Show
videos.overview: Fran's date with a highly superstitious hockey star sours after he claims she's a jinx.

videos.title: That's Midlife
videos.overview: The combination of a bad review and losing to Fran on the tennis court plunges Maxwell into a mid-life crisis.

videos.title: The Cantor Show
videos.overview: Fran's attempt to impress a handsome cantor at her mother's temple backfires when he's suddenly made the star in Maxwell's latest musical.

videos.title: Green Card
videos.overview: Maxwell is upset when Fran falls for Brighton's handsome French tutor.

videos.title: Ship of Fran's
videos.overview: Maxwell arranges for everyone to join Fran on a Caribbean cruise.

videos.title: A Pup in Paris
videos.overview: A mix up ends with Fran joining Maxwell on a romantic trip to Paris.

videos.title: The Tart with Heart
videos.overview: Upon returning from Paris, Maxwell takes back his loving words to Fran.

videos.title: The Cradle Robbers
videos.overview: Ordered to discourage Maggie from seeing an older guy, Fran suddenly finds herself dating his best friend.

videos.title: The Bird's Nest
videos.overview: Brighton faces a year at military school unless he improves his grades at school.

videos.title: The Rosie Show
videos.overview: Fran is hired as a regular on The Rosie O'Donnell Show.

videos.title: Freida Needa Man
videos.overview: Fran's Aunt Freida arrives at the Sheffield's after being evicted.

videos.title: Me and Mrs. Joan
videos.overview: Fran arranges a reunion between Maxwell and his estranged father, James.

videos.title: The Taxman Cometh
videos.overview: While she's supposed to be watching Jay Leno's dog, Fran is distracted by an untimely tax audit.

videos.title: An Affair to Dismember
videos.overview: As Fran wonders what to do about her flagging love life, Maxwell's handsome younger brother proposes marriage.

videos.title: Tattoo
videos.overview: Maxwell is aroused after learning that Fran has a secret tattoo.

videos.title: The Car Show
videos.overview: Fran enters a beauty contest to win a car for Maggie's birthday.

videos.title: Hurricane Fran
videos.overview: Fran decides on a holiday vacation away from the Sheffield's, only to find herself caught in a hurricane.

videos.title: Danny's Dead and Who's Got the Will?
videos.overview: Fran goes to her former fiancé Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.

videos.title: Kissing Cousins
videos.overview: Fran's finds the perfect new boyfriend, only to discover that he's also her cousin.

videos.title: The Fifth Wheel
videos.overview: At the advice of her therapist, Fran is determined to rid her life of men.

videos.title: The Nose Knows
videos.overview: Maxwell suspects Fran's therapist is pushing her into an affair.

videos.title: The Bank Robbery
videos.overview: Fran and Sylvia are taken hostage in a Valentine's Day bank robbery.

videos.title: Samson, He Denied Her
videos.overview: Fran joins C.C. on the jury of a controversial case.

videos.title: The Facts of Lice
videos.overview: Fran suspects Niles if being a killer.

videos.title: Fran's Roots
videos.overview: Fran discovers she may have been switched at birth with the daughter of wealthy parents.

videos.title: The Nanny and the Hunk Producer
videos.overview: A tabloid starts to publish fake stories about Maxwell and Fran having an affair when Maxwell was still married.

videos.title: The Passed-Over Story
videos.overview: A successful high school classmate of Fran's tempts Maggie with a job offer.

videos.title: No Muse is Good Muse
videos.overview: Fran convinces a rock star to let her be her muse.

videos.title: You Bette Your Life
videos.overview: Fran offers her services for a charity auction presided over by Bette Midler.

videos.title: The Heather Biblow Story
videos.overview: Fran's old nemesis lands a role on a popular soap opera.

videos.title: The Boca Story
videos.overview: Fran is upset after learning her mother is planning to move to Florida.

videos.title: Fran's Gotta Have It
videos.overview: Fran's attempt to cement her relationship with Maxwell is rudely interrupted when Niles has a heart attack.

videos.title: The Morning After
videos.overview: Worried that Maxwell is going to abandon her, Fran seeks advice from her cousin Sheila.

videos.title: First Date
videos.overview: Maxwell invites Fran to an exclusive dinner with singer Elton John.

videos.title: The Bobbie Fleckman Story
videos.overview: Fran is led to believe that a female record company executive is after Maxwell.

videos.title: Fransom
videos.overview: Fran takes a job walking C.C.'s dog, only to have it kidnapped.

videos.title: The Ex-Niles
videos.overview: Fran and C.C. appeal to Dr. Joyce Brothers to decide who's best for Maxwell; Niles' snooping gets him fired.

videos.title: A Decent Proposal
videos.overview: Fran's date with comedian Chevy Chase makes Maxwell jealous.

videos.title: Mommy and Mai
videos.overview: Fran and Val square when the Southeast Asian girl they adopted years ago comes to town.

videos.title: Fair Weather Fran
videos.overview: Yetta's fiancé gets Fran an audition with newsman Bryant Gumbel.

videos.title: Educating Fran
videos.overview: Maggie's philosophy professor falls for Fran.

videos.title: From Flushing with Love
videos.overview: Fran uses a trip to Niagara Falls to inspire Maxwell to propose.

videos.title: Rash to Judgment
videos.overview: Fran's attempt to treat her hemorrhoids proves embarrassing.

videos.title: One False Mole and You're Dead
videos.overview: Fran accidentally discovers the secret behind a movie star's famous beauty mark.

videos.title: Call Me Fran
videos.overview: Fran traces her problems with Maxwell back to her relationship with her own father.

videos.title: Not Without My Nanny
videos.overview: Fran and Grace visit a Middle Eastern prince and his family.

videos.title: The Engagement
videos.overview: Maxwell asks Fran to get married.

videos.overview: A trip to her high school reunion leaves Fran with second thoughts about getting married.

videos.title: Immaculate Concepcion
videos.overview: An illegitimate sister comes forward to claim the Sheffield family fortune.

videos.title: The Pre-nup
videos.overview: The wedding is jeopardized when Maxwell demands that Fran sign a pre-nuptial agreement.

videos.title: The Best Man
videos.overview: Fran's brief affair with Maxwell's brother threatens to ruin the wedding.

videos.title: The Wedding (1)
videos.overview: Superstition threatens to derail Fran and Maxwell's wedding.

videos.title: The Wedding (2)
videos.overview: Finally, after 5 long years, the wedding day has arrived.

videos.title: The Honeymoon's Overboard
videos.overview: As C.C. and Sylvia mount a search, Fran and Maxwell try to survive after being washed up on a deserted island on their honeymoon.

videos.title: Once a Secretary, Always a Secretary

videos.overview: The parents of Maxwell's late wife contest Fran's adopting the children.

videos.title: Maggie's Boyfriend
videos.overview: Fran is blamed when Maggie moves in with her new boyfriend.

videos.title: I'm Pregnant
videos.overview: After catching her and Michael in bed, Fran learns that Maggie may be pregnant.

videos.title: Mom's the Word
videos.overview: Fran tells Maxwell that she's pregnant and Brighton loses Yetta at the movies.

videos.title: Making Whoopi
videos.overview: Fran turns to a Chinese herbalist in an effort to get pregnant.

videos.title: Oh, Say, Can You Ski?
videos.overview: Maxwell uses a ski trip with the President to take Fran's mind off trying to get pregnant.

videos.overview: Fran's Aunt Frieda evicts Sylvia and Morty from their apartment, forcing them to move into the mansion.

videos.overview: Niles enlists Fran in an effort to impress C.C. by producing a play.
